==Usage==
<pre>{{csv table|
cell 1, cell 2, cell 3
cell 4,cell 5 , cell 6
}}</pre>
{{csv table|
cell 1, cell 2, cell 3
cell 4,cell 5 , cell 6
}}
(leading/trailing spaces don't matter)

<pre>{{csv table|class=wikitable|
cell 1, cell 2, cell 3
cell 4, cell 5, cell 6
}}</pre>
{{csv table|class=wikitable|
cell 1, cell 2, cell 3
cell 4, cell 5, cell 6
}}

<pre>{{csv table|style=background-color: #bb0033; color:#abcdef;|
cell 1, cell 2, cell 3
cell 4, cell 5, cell 6
}}</pre>
{{csv table|style=background-color: #bb0033; color:#abcdef;|
cell 1, cell 2, cell 3
cell 4, cell 5, cell 6
}}
